items.titleZh: 车手健康问题持续，佩雷斯缺席粉丝论坛并休息，准备FP1和FP2比赛
items.summaryZh: 赛戈维亚·佩雷斯因健康问题将缺席粉丝论坛，并在上午休息后尝试参加FP1和FP2的比赛。瓦尔特里·博塔斯将在FP2中恢复参赛，基米·安东内利被认为身体状况良好，可以参加FP1。
items.originalTitle: Further illness issues among the drivers as Sergio Perez will not attend the fan forum and rest this morning before attempting to drive in FP1 and FP2...
items.summaryEn:
Further illness issues among the drivers as Sergio Perez will not attend the fan forum and rest this morning before attempting to drive in FP1 and FP2
Valtteri Bottas will be ready to return in FP2 as well after illness, while Kimi Antonelli is understood to be fit enough to drive in FP1 #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh:
车手们出现进一步的健康问题，塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯将不会参加粉丝论坛，并在今天上午休息，之后尝试在FP1和FP2中驾驶
瓦尔特里·博塔斯将在FP2中准备好回归，因为他也生病了，而基米·安东内利据信身体状况足够良好，可以在FP1中驾驶 #F1 #墨西哥大奖赛
detailEn:
Further illness issues among the drivers as Sergio Perez will not attend the fan forum and rest this morning before attempting to drive in FP1 and FP2
Valtteri Bottas will be ready to return in FP2 as well after illness, while Kimi Antonelli is understood to be fit enough to drive in FP1 #F1 #MexicoGP

items.titleZh: 墨西哥城赛道带来年度最具挑战性的工程难题
items.summaryZh: 墨西哥城赛道和城市海拔超过2200米，对车辆、车手和整个车队都是一大挑战。

media.altZh: 墨西哥城赛道带来年度最具挑战性的工程难题 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: "Mexico City presents one of the most interesting engineering challenges of the year due to the circuit and city altitude being in excess of 2200m. Th...
items.summaryEn:
"Mexico City presents one of the most interesting engineering challenges of the year due to the circuit and city altitude being in excess of 2200m. This means that it is a very tough race on cars, drivers, and the wider team. It also makes for a rather breathless track run." 🗣️ HN
To learn more about our partnership with Mphasis, visit the link in our bio 🔗
#HaasF1 #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh: 墨西哥城赛道由于其赛道和城市海拔超过2200米，成为今年最具挑战性的工程难题之一。这意味着这是一场对汽车、车手以及整个车队都非常艰难的比赛。这也使得赛道变得非常紧张刺激。
detailEn:
"Mexico City presents one of the most interesting engineering challenges of the year due to the circuit and city altitude being in excess of 2200m. This means that it is a very tough race on cars, drivers, and the wider team. It also makes for a rather breathless track run." 🗣️ HN
